title: Experiments of the IGM v3.2.1 model description paper (GMD)
description: Configuration files, user modules, scripts and data to reproduce the experiments and figures of the IGM v3.2.1 model description paper submitted to Geoscientific Model Development: calibration of Aletsch Glacier (1880–2020), scalability test over the Alps, thermal calibration of Drønbreen (Svalbard), and the ISMIP-HOM B and Kleiner et al. (2015) A/B benchmarks.

creators.name: Bacchin, Lucie
creators.affiliation: Universidad Politécnica de Madrid; University Centre in Svalbard (UNIS)
